list.name: An HAProxy janusd doesn't run listens
list.titleFormat: An HAProxy janusd doesn't run listens

description: Janus nodes through the Janus exporter every node serves (:10056) - https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/metrics.md

panels.description: Janus exporters answering Prometheus, and those that don't.
panels.title: Nodes

panels.description: Nodes whose HAProxy answers on its stats socket (janus_haproxy_up), and those whose doesn't.
panels.title: HAProxy

panels.description: The soonest expiry among every certificate the selected nodes report: their API's CA and server certificates, and every certificate HAProxy has loaded. Orange under 14 days (the JanusCertificateExpiresSoon alert), red under 7.
panels.title: Next certificate expiry

panels.description: Nodes with an upgrade waiting for its health confirmation, a network configuration or a firewall ruleset on trial: each reverts unless confirmed.
panels.title: Awaiting confirmation

panels.description: Nodes not enforcing SELinux, and the denials their kernels logged over the dashboard's time range - there should be none.
panels.title: SELinux

panels.description: Processes the kernel killed for lack of memory over the time range, and errors the kernel recorded on STATE (PKI, configuration).
panels.title: Kernel and STATE

panels.description: One line per node: what it runs and how it is. Janus = the release, Schematic = the [image schematic](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/image-factory.md), Slot = the A/B slot it booted, Boot = seconds from the kernel's start to the API listening (firmware not counted), Clock offset = measured at the last NTP synchronization.
panels.title: Fleet

panels.description: Whether each node's HAProxy answers on its stats socket (janus_haproxy_up). "no answer": the node's exporter itself didn't answer.

targets.expr: max by (instance) (janus_haproxy_up{job="$job", instance=~"$instance"}) or (max by (instance) (up{job="$job", instance=~"$instance"}) - 1)

panels.title: HAProxy

panels.description: Seamless reloads, HAProxy processes that exited without being stopped or replaced (crashes), and configurations applied through the API, accepted or rejected - per interval. Nothing drawn: nothing happened.

targets.expr: (sum by (instance) (janus_haproxy_reloads_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance"}) - sum by (instance) (janus_haproxy_reloads_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance"} offset $__interval)) > 0

(sum by (instance) (janus_haproxy_unexpected_exits_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance"}) - sum by (instance) (janus_haproxy_unexpected_exits_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance"} offset $__interval)) > 0

(sum by (instance, result) (janus_haproxy_config_applies_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance"}) - sum by (instance, result) (janus_haproxy_config_applies_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance"} offset $__interval)) > 0

panels.title: Reloads, crashes and configurations

panels.description: Every certificate the nodes report: their API's CA and server certificates (source api), and every certificate HAProxy has loaded, by file or store name (source haproxy). Orange under 14 days, red under 7.

targets.expr: max by (instance, source, certificate, cn) (janus_certificate_expiry_timestamp_seconds{job="$job", instance=~"$instance"}) - time()
max by (instance, source, certificate, cn) (janus_certificate_expiry_timestamp_seconds{job="$job", instance=~"$instance"}) * 1000

panels.title: Certificates

panels.description: Certificates the [letsencrypt extension](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/letsencrypt.md) obtains: their state, when each was last obtained and becomes due for renewal, and failed attempts in a row (orange from 1, red from 3).
panels.title: Let's Encrypt

panels.description: Whether the ACME CA knows the account of each node that has Let's Encrypt certificates configured.

targets.expr: max by (instance) (janus_acme_account_registered{job="$job", instance=~"$instance"}) and on (instance) count by (instance) (janus_acme_certificate_state{job="$job", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: ACME account

panels.description: Each extension service janusd supervises ([image factory](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/image-factory.md)): running, waiting for the files it needs (its configuration - normal until it is configured), restarting after it exited (backoff), or stopped on purpose.

targets.expr: sum by (instance, service) (janus_service_state{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", state="running"}) + 2 * sum by (instance, service) (janus_service_state{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", state="waiting"}) + 3 * sum by (instance, service) (janus_service_state{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", state="restarting"}) + 4 * sum by (instance, service) (janus_service_state{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", state="stopped"})

panels.title: Services

panels.description: The extensions built into each node's image ([image factory](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/image-factory.md)), and their versions.
panels.title: Extensions

panels.description: Times each extension service exited and was restarted, per interval. Nothing drawn: no restart.

targets.expr: (sum by (instance, service) (janus_service_restarts_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance"}) - sum by (instance, service) (janus_service_restarts_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance"} offset $__interval)) > 0

panels.title: Service restarts

panels.description: An upgrade waiting for its health confirmation, a network configuration or a firewall ruleset on trial: each reverts unless confirmed.
panels.title: Awaiting confirmation

panels.description: Seconds after the kernel started at which each stage of the last boot completed: the kernel handed over to init, init started janusd, HAProxy served, the API listened. The firmware's own time comes before and isn't counted.
panels.title: Last boot

panels.description: The offset janusd's NTP client measured at its last synchronization.
panels.title: Clock offset

panels.description: Over an hour (the dashed line) the JanusClockNotSynchronized alert fires.
panels.title: Time since the last NTP synchronization

panels.description: Calls to each node's gRPC API per second, refused ones included.
panels.title: API calls

panels.description: Calls that didn't end OK, by gRPC code. PermissionDenied and Unauthenticated: callers refused (the JanusAPIRefusals alert); NotFound, FailedPrecondition... are ordinary answers. Nothing drawn: no error.
panels.title: API errors

panels.description: Each VRRP instance's state ([VRRP](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/vrrp.md), the keepalived extension). The instance's name is the exported_instance label: Prometheus renames the exporter's instance label.

targets.expr: sum by (instance, exported_instance) (janus_vrrp_instance_state{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", state="MASTER"}) + 2 * sum by (instance, exported_instance) (janus_vrrp_instance_state{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", state="BACKUP"}) + 3 * sum by (instance, exported_instance) (janus_vrrp_instance_state{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", state="FAULT"}) + 4 * sum by (instance, exported_instance) (janus_vrrp_instance_state{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", state="INIT"}) + 5 * sum by (instance, exported_instance) (janus_vrrp_instance_state{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", state="STOP"})

panels.title: VRRP instances

panels.description: Each VRRP instance's priority after tracking (a failed track_file - HAProxy not serving - lowers it).
panels.title: VRRP priority

panels.description: Each BGP session ([BGP](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/bgp.md), the bird extension), and each haproxy_* protocol janusd holds down while HAProxy doesn't answer.
panels.title: BGP sessions

panels.description: Routes each BIRD protocol imported and exported.
panels.title: BGP routes

panels.description: Elements in each named set of the live nftables ruleset ([firewall](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/firewall.md), the nftables extension).

targets.expr: max by (instance, family, table, set) (janus_firewall_set_elements{job="$job", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Firewall sets
